    if not data:
        return

    n = next(it)
    m = next(it)
    c = next(it)

    nxt = [0] * (m + 1)

        a = next(it)

    trocas = 0

        if nxt[cur] == 0:

            print(-1)
            return

        cur = nxt[cur]
